why: Release artifact 6d45c4126c010b5972a203a47d85a7a72dd1a43415b10266a9a7adfefdc21223 was built and measured by GitHub Actions run 43216612027 attempt 1 at commit a30a64f8e37520b2923629c020ef1418499aea8b; this record re-measures the ten-second terminal gate the earlier local captures described, on the artifact that run produced.

local.command: pnpm smoke:local-cold-start -- --app-path $PWD/src-tauri/target/release/terminal (invoked 3 times, one measured run per invocation)
local.probe: Rust TERMINAL_SHELL_PROBE marker written only after the frontend sent its nonce through xterm -> session_write -> local PTY and read the marker back

source.note: Computed over FINGERPRINT_PATHS by scripts/check-verification-evidence.mjs on the checked-out CI sources at evidence build time.

limitations: This is automated evidence. It does not cover a human on a physical keyboard, Chinese IME composition, Option/dead keys, or vim/nano editing.
The remote SSH prompt gate for the release profile is measured in 2026-10-11-macos-release-ssh-matrix.json, not in this file.
Measured on a GitHub-hosted macOS virtual machine; real lid-close sleep/wake, VPN and cellular handover recovery remain unobserved on hardware.
The binary is unsigned and unnotarised; first-launch Gatekeeper behaviour on a clean machine is still unverified.
Windows OpenSSH Agent, Pageant, ConPTY/local Windows PTY and serial hardware have no test machine available and are not covered here.
instrumentationCaveat: This binary is built with VITE_TERMINAL_SMOKE_BUILD=1, which compiles the smoke and input-probe entry points and the experiments nav item into the frontend. A shipping build omits all of them, so these numbers describe a slightly larger bundle than a user receives and are a conservative upper bound.
